title:
BTO or resale?
*Wrong question*
caption:
BTO is cheaper but you wait years. Resale is ready now but costs more. 🏠

While you wait, you may be paying rent. So the real question isn't price. It's time.

Which would you choose? Comment BTO or RESALE 👇
